d:
Jharkhand ki pratibhaen ab bare parde par bhi apni pahchan bana rahi hain. khel aur shiksha ke sath kala aur sinema ke kshetr men bhi yahan ke yuvaon ki mehnat rashtriy-antarrashtriy star par dikhaee de rahi hai. isi kari men ranchi ke dhurva nivasi sagar shridh ne philm ‘ramayan’ ke kostayum nirman men apni rachnatmakta aur hunar ka parichay diya hai.
